name: Alpocco · Gremlet #17
description:
A fluffy alpaca with a cloud of a hairdo. Hums when it's content.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Alpocco in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
